_help: Copy to <name>.json (or create it in tentacontrol → Services → Systems). Files starting with '_' are ignored.
A system groups the services of one host or appliance. Services join with "system": "<name>" in their JSON.
ssh_host: alias from ssh/config.d – docker services of mode ssh without their own ssh_host use it.
notes: rules that apply to every service of the system (shown in svc info and the service catalog).
name: example
description: VPS example.org – reverse proxy and mail
notes: Restarting the proxy interrupts all sites – ask first.
